AFPE v1.0 is a historical county detection compilation and is stale for current-source readiness. A value of 1 supports recorded-present only, not current abundance or complete distribution. A value of 0 is never verified absence or survey non-detection. The published files provide common names and DCA columns, so taxon publication is limited to the 13 manually reviewed mappings.
